**Key Points** 

	**मध्य प्रदेश के मुरैना जिले** में स्थित **चौसठ योगिनी मंदिर** को **एकत्तरसो महादेव मंदिर** के नाम से भी जाना जाता है।
	**"एकत्तरसो महादेव"** नाम मंदिर परिसर के भीतर **71 छोटे मंदिरों** की उपस्थिति से लिया गया है। विशेष रूप से, इसमें **योगिनियों** को समर्पित **64 कक्ष** और एक केंद्रीय मंदिर के साथ-साथ अन्य मंदिर **भगवान शिव** को समर्पित हैं।
	इसका निर्माण **14वीं शताब्दी** में, विशेष रूप से **1323 ईस्वी** के आसपास, **कच्छपघात राजवंश** के **राजा देवपाल** के शासनकाल के दौरान किया गया था।
	यह मंदिर अपनी **गोलाकार संरचना** के लिए अद्वितीय है और भारत में कुछ अच्छी तरह से संरक्षित **हाइपेथ्रल** (आकाश की ओर खुला) मंदिरों में से एक है। यह **मितावली गांव** में लगभग **100 फीट** ऊंची पहाड़ी पर स्थित है।
	वास्तुशिल्प इतिहासकारों का व्यापक रूप से मानना है कि इस मंदिर ने **नई दिल्ली** में **पुराने संसद भवन (संसद भवन)** के लिए डिजाइन प्रेरणा के रूप में कार्य किया था, जिसे **1920 के दशक** में ब्रिटिश वास्तुकारों **एडविन लुटियंस** और **हर्बर्ट बेकर** द्वारा तैयार किया गया था।
	मंदिर का रखरखाव और संरक्षण **भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण (ASI)** द्वारा राष्ट्रीय महत्व के स्मारक के रूप में किया जाता है।

 **Additional Information**

	**विरुपाक्ष मंदिर:**

	
		**कर्नाटक** के **बल्लारी जिले** में **हम्पी** में स्थित, यह **हम्पी में स्मारकों के समूह** का एक हिस्सा है, जो **यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल** है।
		यह **भगवान शिव** को समर्पित है, जिन्हें यहाँ **विरुपाक्ष** के रूप में जाना जाता है, जो स्थानीय देवी **पम्पा** के पति हैं।
		मंदिर का निर्माण **विजयनगर साम्राज्य** के शासक **देव राय द्वितीय** के अधीन एक सेनापति **लक्कन दंडेश** द्वारा किया गया था। यह अपने विशाल **गोपुरम** और **द्रविड़ वास्तुकला** के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
	
	
	**सोमनाथ मंदिर:**
	
		**गुजरात के सौराष्ट्र** में **वेरावल** के पास **प्रभास पाटन** में स्थित, इसे **भगवान शिव** के **बारह ज्योतिर्लिंग** मंदिरों में **प्रथम** माना जाता है।
		इतिहास में कई बार मंदिर को नष्ट किया गया और पुनर्निर्मित किया गया। वर्तमान संरचना हिंदू मंदिर वास्तुकला की **मारू-गुर्जर शैली** (चालुक्य शैली) में पुनर्निर्मित की गई थी और **मई 1951** में पूरी हुई थी।
		भारत की स्वतंत्रता के बाद **सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल** द्वारा पुनर्निर्माण की पहल की गई थी।
	
	
	**दिलवाड़ा मंदिर:**
	
		ये **राजस्थान** में **माउंट आबू** बस्ती से लगभग 2.5 किलोमीटर दूर स्थित **पांच श्वेतांबर जैन मंदिरों** का एक समूह हैं।
		**11वीं और 16वीं शताब्दी** के बीच निर्मित, वे अपनी शानदार **संगमरमर की नक्काशी** और जटिल वास्तुशिल्प विवरणों के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध हैं।
		इनमें से सबसे पुराना, **विमल वसाही मंदिर**, **1031 ईस्वी** में **चालुक्य राजा भीम प्रथम** के मंत्री **विमल शाह** द्वारा बनाया गया था।
	
	
	**योगिनी मंदिरों का महत्व:**
	
		**योगिनी पंथ** एक **तांत्रिक** परंपरा थी जो **9वीं और 12वीं शताब्दी** के बीच फली-फूली।
		अन्य उल्लेखनीय चौसठ योगिनी मंदिर **खजुराहो (मध्य प्रदेश)**, **हीरापुर (ओडिशा)** और **रानीपुर-झरियाल (ओडिशा)** में स्थित हैं।
		इन मंदिरों का **गोलाकार आकार** अक्सर **श्री यंत्र** या **धर्मचक्र** से जुड़ा होता है, जो ऊर्जा के ब्रह्मांडीय प्रवाह का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

questions.questionText: A typical example of early cave architecture is the Lomas Rishi cave in the Barabar Hills of ____.
questions.questionTextHi: प्रारंभिक गुफा स्थापत्य कला का एक विशिष्ट उदाहरण, ____ की बराबर पहाड़ियों में स्थित लोमस ऋषि गुफा है।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Bihar**.

**Key Points**

The **Lomas Rishi Cave** is a prominent example of early **rock-cut architecture** located in the **Barabar Hills** in the **Jehanabad district** of **Bihar**.
It was constructed during the **Mauryan period** in the **3rd century BCE**, making it one of the oldest surviving rock-cut caves in **India**.
The cave is famous for its **ornamental facade**, which mimics contemporary **wooden architecture** of that era, specifically resembling the front of a thatched-roof hut.
The entrance is decorated with a row of **elephants** in a semi-circular frieze, moving towards **Stupa** symbols, showcasing the early artistic mastery of the **Mauryan** artisans.
This cave represents the formative stage of the **Chaitya arch** (horseshoe arch) that became a defining feature of later **Buddhist** cave temples.
***Hence, the correct answer is Bihar.***

**Additional Information**

**Barabar Caves Group**:

The **Barabar Hill Caves** consist of four main caves: **Lomas Rishi**, **Sudama**, **Karan Chaupar**, and **Visva Zopri**.
The **Sudama cave** is considered the earliest in the group, dedicated by **Emperor Ashoka** in the **12th year** of his reign (around **261 BCE**).

**Ajivika Sect**:

Most of these caves were primarily dedicated by the **Mauryan** emperors **Ashoka** and his grandson **Dasharatha** to the **Ajivikas**.
The **Ajivika** was a major heterodox ascetic sect of ancient **India** that competed with **Buddhism** and **Jainism**.

**Architectural Significance**:

A characteristic feature of **Mauryan** caves is the **Mauryan polish**, which gives the interior granite surfaces a mirror-like finish.
This technique reflects the advanced masonry skills developed during the **Mauryan Empire**.

**Important Points**

**Nagarjuni Caves**:

Located about **2 km** from the **Barabar Hills**, the **Nagarjuni Hills** contain three more caves, including the **Gopi cave**.
Inscriptions found here mention **Dasharatha Maurya**, the grandson of **Ashoka**, confirming the continued royal patronage of the region in the late **3rd century BCE**.

**Internal Layout**:

The **Lomas Rishi cave** consists of two rooms: a large rectangular **hall** (mandapa) and a smaller, circular **inner chamber** (shrine) with a hemispherical roof.
This layout indicates that the cave was used as a **place of worship** and assembly for the **ascetics**.

**Legacy**:

The architectural style of the **Lomas Rishi** facade directly influenced the later **Buddhist Chaitya halls** at sites such as **Ajanta**, **Karle**, and **Kanheri**.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **बिहार** है।

**Key Points** 

	**लोमस ऋषि गुफा** प्रारंभिक **चट्टानों को काटकर बनाई गई वास्तुकला** का एक प्रमुख उदाहरण है, जो **बिहार** के **जहानाबाद जिले** में **बराबर पहाड़ियों** में स्थित है।
	इसका निर्माण **तीसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व** में **मौर्य काल** के दौरान किया गया था, जो इसे **भारत** में जीवित सबसे पुरानी चट्टानों को काटकर बनाई गई गुफाओं में से एक बनाता है।
	यह गुफा अपने **अलंकृत अग्रभाग (facade)** के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, जो उस युग की समकालीन **लकड़ी की वास्तुकला** की नकल करती है, विशेष रूप से फूस की छत वाली झोपड़ी के सामने के हिस्से के समान है।
	प्रवेश द्वार को एक अर्ध-वृत्ताकार फ्रिज़ में **हाथियों** की एक पंक्ति से सजाया गया है, जो **स्तूप** प्रतीकों की ओर बढ़ रहे हैं, जो **मौर्य** कारीगरों की प्रारंभिक कलात्मक महारत को प्रदर्शित करते हैं।
	यह गुफा **चैत्य मेहराब** (घोड़े की नाल के आकार का मेहराब) के प्रारंभिक चरण का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है जो बाद के **बौद्ध** गुफा मंदिरों की एक परिभाषित विशेषता बन गई।
	***अतः, सही उत्तर बिहार है।***

**Additional Information** 

	**बराबर गुफा समूह**:

	
		**बराबर पहाड़ी गुफाओं** में चार मुख्य गुफाएं शामिल हैं: **लोमस ऋषि**, **सुदामा**, **करण चौपर**, और **विश्व झोपड़ी**।
		**सुदामा गुफा** को समूह में सबसे पुरानी माना जाता है, जिसे **सम्राट अशोक** ने अपने शासनकाल के **12वें वर्ष** (लगभग **261 ईसा पूर्व**) में समर्पित किया था।
	
	
	**आजीविका संप्रदाय**:
	
		इनमें से अधिकांश गुफाएं मुख्य रूप से **मौर्य** सम्राटों **अशोक** और उनके पोते **दशरथ** द्वारा **आजीविकों** को समर्पित की गई थीं।
		**आजीविका** प्राचीन **भारत** का एक प्रमुख विधर्मी तपस्वी संप्रदाय था जो **बौद्ध धर्म** और **जैन धर्म** के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करता था।
	
	
	**वास्तुशिल्प महत्व**:
	
		मौर्य गुफाओं की एक विशिष्ट विशेषता मौर्यकालीन चिकनाई** है, जो उनकी आंतरिक ग्रेनाइट सतहों को दर्पण जैसी चमक** प्रदान करती है।
		यह तकनीक **मौर्य साम्राज्य** के दौरान विकसित उन्नत चिनाई कौशल को दर्शाती है।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**नागार्जुनी गुफाएं**:

	
		**बराबर पहाड़ियों** से लगभग **2 किमी** दूर स्थित, **नागार्जुनी पहाड़ियों** में तीन और गुफाएं हैं, जिनमें **गोपी गुफा** भी शामिल है।
		यहाँ पाए गए शिलालेखों में **अशोक** के पोते **दशरथ मौर्य** का उल्लेख है, जो **तीसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व** के अंत में इस क्षेत्र के निरंतर शाही संरक्षण की पुष्टि करते हैं।
	
	
	**आंतरिक विन्यास**:
	
		**लोमस ऋषि गुफा** में दो कमरे हैं: एक बड़ा आयताकार सभागार और एक छोटा, गोलाकार **आंतरिक कक्ष** (गर्भगृह) जिसकी छत अर्धगोलाकार है।
		यह विन्यास इंगित करता है कि गुफा का उपयोग **तपस्वियों** के लिए **पूजा स्थल** और सभा स्थल के रूप में किया जाता था।
	
	
	**विरासत**:
	
		**लोमस ऋषि** अग्रभाग की वास्तुशिल्प शैली ने सीधे तौर पर **अजंता**, **कार्ले** और **कान्हेरी** जैसे स्थलों पर बाद के **बौद्ध चैत्य **सभागारो को प्रभावित किया।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding thumri?

I. The thumri is very lyrical in its structure and presentation.

II. Thumri is a love song and hence the textual beauty is very important.
questions.questionTextHi:
ठुमरी के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?

I. ठुमरी अपनी संरचना और प्रस्तुति में बहुत गीतात्मक होती है।

II. ठुमरी एक प्रेम गीत है और इसलिए इसका पाठ्य सौंदर्य बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।

options.textHi: ना तो I तथा ना ही II

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Both I and II**.

**Key Points**

**Thumri** is a prominent genre of **semi-classical Indian music** that is characterized by its **lyrical structure** and expressive presentation. Unlike the more rigid **Khayal**, it prioritizes the **melodic rendering of words** to evoke specific emotions. ***Hence, statement I is correct.***
The genre is fundamentally a **love song**, often revolving around the themes of **romantic longing**, **devotion**, and the **shringara rasa** (the sentiment of love).
Because **Thumri** is centered on emotional expression, the **textual beauty** and the meaning of the lyrics are of paramount importance. The performer uses **musical ornamentations** to highlight the nuances of the poetry. ***Hence, statement II is correct.***
The compositions are usually set in **Braj Bhasha**, **Awadhi**, or **Bhojpuri** dialects, which lend a rustic yet sophisticated charm to the **textual content**.
***Hence, the correct answer is Both I and II.***

**Additional Information**

**Origins and History:**

**Thumri** rose to significant popularity in the **19th Century** within the **royal courts** of **North India**.
It received immense patronage from **Nawab Wajid Ali Shah**, the last Nawab of **Awadh**, who was himself a great poet and musician under the pen name **'Akhtarpiya'**.

**Regional Schools (Gharanas):**

There are two main styles or **gharanas** of **Thumri**: the **Lucknow Thumri** and the **Benares (Varanasi) Thumri**.
The **Lucknow style** is known for its **grace** and **delicacy**, often linked with the **Kathak** dance tradition.
The **Benares style** is characterized by a **robust** and **earthy** quality, focusing heavily on the **'Bol-Banao'** technique where a single line of text is interpreted in multiple melodic ways.

**Musical Features:**

The **Ragas** used in **Thumri** are generally "light" or **'chhota' ragas** such as **Kafi**, **Khamaj**, **Bhairavi**, **Piloo**, and **Des**.
The common **Taals** (rhythmic cycles) associated with this genre include **Deepchandi**, **Dadra**, **Kaherva**, and **Jat**.
The compositions often depict the **divine love** between **Radha and Krishna**, serving as a metaphor for the human soul's longing for the divine.

**Important Points**

**Famous Exponents:**

Legendary singers like **Girija Devi** (often called the **'Queen of Thumri'**), **Begum Akhtar**, **Shobha Gurtu**, and **Bade Ghulam Ali Khan** have made monumental contributions to this art form.
**Girija Devi** was instrumental in bringing the **Purab Ang Thumri** to the global stage and was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan** in **2016**.

**Performance Techniques:**

**Bol-Banao:** The act of using **musical improvisation** to describe the meaning of the **words (Bol)**.
**Bol-Baant:** The use of **rhythmic variations** and distributions of the **lyrics** within the time cycle.
Traditionally, **Thumri** was accompanied by the **Sarangi** and **Tabla**, though the **Harmonium** is now more commonly used.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **I और II दोनों** है।

**Key Points** 

	**ठुमरी** **अर्ध-शास्त्रीय भारतीय संगीत** की एक प्रमुख शैली है जो अपनी **काव्यात्मक संरचना** और अभिव्यंजक प्रस्तुति के लिए जानी जाती है। अधिक कठोर **ख्याल** के विपरीत, यह विशिष्ट भावनाओं को जगाने के लिए **शब्दों के मधुर गायन** को प्राथमिकता देती है। ***अतः, कथन I सही है।***
	यह शैली मूल रूप से एक **प्रेम गीत** है, जो अक्सर प्रेमपूर्ण ****लालसा**, **भक्ति** और **शृंगार रस** (प्रेम की भावना) के विषयों के इर्द-गिर्द घूमती है।
	चूंकि **ठुमरी** भावनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति पर केंद्रित है, इसलिए **पाठ्य सुंदरता** और गीतों का अर्थ सर्वोपरि महत्व का है। कलाकार कविता की बारीकियों को उजागर करने के लिए **संगीत अलंकरणों** का उपयोग करता है। ***अतः, कथन II सही है।***
	रचनाएं आमतौर पर **ब्रज भाषा**, **अवधी**, या **भोजपुरी** बोलियों में रची जाती हैं, जो **पाठ्य सामग्री** को एक देहाती लेकिन परिष्कृत आकर्षण प्रदान करती हैं।
	***अतः, सही उत्तर I और II दोनों है।***

**Additional Information** 

	**उत्पत्ति और इतिहास:**

	
		**ठुमरी** **19वीं शताब्दी** में **उत्तर भारत** के **शाही दरबारों** में काफी लोकप्रिय हुई।
		इसे **अवध** के अंतिम नवाब, **नवाब वाजिद अली शाह** से अपार संरक्षण प्राप्त हुआ, जो स्वयं **'अख्तरपिया'** उपनाम से एक महान कवि और संगीतकार थे।
	
	
	**क्षेत्रीय घराने:**
	
		**ठुमरी** की दो मुख्य शैलियाँ या **घराने** हैं: **लखनऊ ठुमरी** और **बनारस (वाराणसी) ठुमरी**।
		**लखनऊ शैली** अपनी **गरिमा** और **नजाकत** के लिए जानी जाती है, जो अक्सर **कथक** नृत्य परंपरा से जुड़ी होती है।
		**बनारस शैली** अपनी **मजबूत** और **मिट्टी की सोंधी** गुणवत्ता के लिए जानी जाती है, जो मुख्य रूप से **'बोल-बनाव'** तकनीक पर केंद्रित है जहाँ पाठ की एक ही पंक्ति को कई मधुर तरीकों से व्याख्यायित किया जाता है।
	
	
	**संगीत संबंधी विशेषताएं:**
	
		**ठुमरी** में प्रयुक्त **राग** आम तौर पर "हल्के" या **'छोटे' राग** होते हैं जैसे **काफी**, **खमाज**, **भैरवी**, **पीलू** और **देस**।
		इस शैली से जुड़े सामान्य **ताल** (लयबद्ध चक्र) में **दीपचंदी**, **दादरा**, **कहरवा** और **जत** शामिल हैं।
		रचनाएं अक्सर **राधा और कृष्ण** के बीच **दिव्य प्रेम** को चित्रित करती हैं, जो परमात्मा के लिए मानव आत्मा की लालसा के रूपक के रूप में कार्य करती हैं।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**प्रसिद्ध प्रतिपादक:**

	
		**गिरजा देवी** (जिन्हें अक्सर **'ठुमरी की रानी'** कहा जाता है), **बेगम अख्तर**, **शोभा गुर्टू** और **बड़े गुलाम अली खान** जैसे दिग्गज गायकों ने इस कला रूप में स्मारकीय योगदान दिया है।
		**गिरजा देवी** ने **पूरब अंग ठुमरी** को वैश्विक मंच पर लाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी और उन्हें **2016** में **पद्म विभूषण** से सम्मानित किया गया था।
	
	
	**प्रदर्शन तकनीक:**
	
		**बोल-बनाव:** **शब्दों (बोल)** के अर्थ का वर्णन करने के लिए **संगीत सुधार (इम्प्रोवाइज़ेशन)** का उपयोग करने की क्रिया।
		**बोल-बाँट:** समय चक्र के भीतर **गीतों** के **लयबद्ध विविधताओं** और वितरण का उपयोग।
		पारंपरिक रूप से, **ठुमरी** के साथ **सारंगी** और **तबला** बजाया जाता था, हालांकि अब **हारमोनियम** का अधिक सामान्यतः उपयोग किया जाता है।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following idioms given in the alternatives has the meaning?

To desire to go back to a previous point in the past to change or undo events or actions that are now regretted.

options.text: Turn back the hands of time
Arrive somewhere up on the stroke of some time

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Turn back the hands of time**.

**Key Points**

The idiom **"Turn back the hands of time"** means to desire to go back to a previous point in time to change or undo events or actions that are now regretted. (समय को पीछे मोड़ना चाहते हैं)

**Example:** If I could turn back the hands of time, I would undo the mistakes I made during my youth.

This idiom is metaphorical and is commonly used in situations where people express regret over past events. (भूतकाल के लिए पछतावा व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Turn back the hands of time**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Option 2: In the fullness of time** (समय आने पर): Refers to something happening eventually, when the time is right.

**Example:** In the fullness of time, we will see the results of our efforts.

**Option 3: Turn around time** (पलटने का समय): Refers to the time taken to complete a process or task.

**Example:** The turn-around time for repairing this device is approximately two weeks.

**Option 4: Arrive somewhere up on the stroke of some time** (सटीक समय पर पहुँचना): Refers to arriving exactly at a specific time.

**Example:** She arrived at the party on the stroke of 8 PM.

questions.questionText:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

To even the score.

options.text: To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal
To score a point from a particular situation or setup
To get points equal with the opponent
To be within the distance from which scoring a goal

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal**.

**Key Points**

The idiom **"To even the score"** means to settle a dispute or redress a wrong by avenging or rectifying an unfair situation. (गिनती बराबर करना/बदला लेना)

**Example:** After being cheated in the game, he was determined to even the score by winning the next round.

It implies taking action to make things fair or balanced, especially after being wronged. (संतुलन बनाना)

**Example:** She worked hard to even the score with her competitor in the final race.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Option 2:** **To score a point from a particular situation or setup** (किसी विशेष परिस्थिति से अंक प्राप्त करना)

**Example:** He scored a point due to his quick reflexes during the penalty shootout.

**Option 3:** **To get points equal with the opponent** (प्रतिद्वंद्वी के साथ अंक बराबर करना)

**Example:** The player evened the score by hitting a six in the last over.

**Option 4:** **To be within the distance from which scoring a goal** (गोल करने की दूरी के भीतर होना)

**Example:** The striker moved closer to the goal to be within the scoring distance.

questions.questionText:

questions.explanation:

The irascible old man shouted at the children playing in the street.

questions.questionText:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.

The company announced a dividend for its shareholders, citing a remarkable rise in profits despite the volatelity of global financial markets.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is** option 4.**

**Key Points**

The misspelt word in the sentence is **'volatelity.'**
**The correct spelling is 'volatility.'**
The word **'volatility'** is a noun that refers to the quality of being subject to frequent, rapid, or unexpected changes, especially in financial markets.
**For Example:** The stock market is known for its volatility during uncertain times.

Correct sentence: The company announced a dividend for its shareholders, citing a remarkable rise in profits despite the volatility of global financial markets.

**Additional Information**

**Dividend:** A sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders out of its profits.
**Shareholders:** Individuals or entities that own shares in a company.
**Remarkable:** Worthy of attention; extraordinary.

questions.questionText: Choose the misspelt word from the given options.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

**Key Points**

**The misspelled word is 'Retribyution'.**

**The correct spelling would be 'Retribution'.**
The word '**Retribution**' is a **noun** which means 'punishment inflicted on someone as vengeance for a wrong or criminal act' **(प्रतिशोध).**

**For Example -**
He faced severe retribution for his actions.

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Retribyution'.**

**Additional Information**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

**Independence -** freedom from outside control; self-governance **(स्वतंत्रता)**
**Connotation - **an idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal meaning **(अर्थ का सूचक)**
**Ignoreamus -** a person who is ignorant or lacks knowledge **(अज्ञानी व्यक्ति)**

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "depth".
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **4) Shallowness**.

**Key Points**

The word **"depth"** refers to the quality of being deep, whether physically or metaphorically. It can also mean profoundness or intensity in thought or emotion. (गहराई)

**Example:** The depth of his knowledge in science is truly remarkable.

**"Shallowness"** is the opposite of "depth," meaning a lack of depth, either physically or metaphorically. It can refer to superficiality or a lack of seriousness or thought. (उथलापन)

**Example:** The conversation lacked substance and was marked by its shallowness.

Hence, the most opposite word to **'depth'** is **'shallowness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **4) Shallowness**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Intensity** (तीव्रता): Refers to the degree or magnitude of strength, force, or emotion.

**Example:** The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.

**Abyss** (अथाह गहराई): Refers to a deep or seemingly bottomless chasm, often metaphorically used to describe a profound void.

**Example:** Staring into the abyss of the canyon was both terrifying and mesmerizing.

**Profundity** (गहनता): Refers to the quality of being profound or insightful, especially in thought or knowledge.

**Example:** The speaker's profundity left the audience in awe.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is the antonym of Generous.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Stingy**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Generous"** means showing kindness and a willingness to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)

**Example:** She is generous with her time and often volunteers to help others.

**"Stingy"** refers to someone who is unwilling to spend or give, often to the point of being miserly. (कंजूस)

**Example:** He is so stingy that he refuses to buy a gift for his friend's birthday.

Hence, the antonym of **"Generous"** is **"Stingy"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Stingy**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Kind** (दयालु): Someone who is considerate and caring towards others.

**Example:** She is kind to everyone she meets, always offering a helping hand.

**Benevolent** (सद्भावपूर्ण): Well-meaning and kindly, often associated with charitable acts.

**Example:** The benevolent ruler established schools and hospitals for his people.

**Charitable** (परोपकारी): Relating to the giving of help, especially to those in need.

**Example:** She donated a large sum of money to charitable organizations.

questions.questionText:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

She bought a _______ of shoes for the party.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**pair**'.

**Key Points**

The word "**pair**" refers to a set of two related items or objects that are used together.
In the context of shoes, a "**pair**" is the correct term, as shoes come in two pieces (left and right).
**Options 1, 3, and 4** are incorrect because:

**Option 1:** "pare" means to trim or reduce, which does not fit the context.
**Option 3:** "peer" refers to a person of the same rank or status, unrelated to shoes.
**Option 4:** "pear" is a fruit and does not apply in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"She bought a **pair** of shoes for the party."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "pare"** is incorrect because it refers to trimming or reducing, not a set of shoes.
**Option 3: "peer"** is unrelated to the context of the sentence.
**Option 4: "pear"** is a fruit and does not make sense in the sentence.

questions.questionText:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who studies handwriting.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Graphologist**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Graphologist"** refers to a person who studies handwriting, especially to analyze a person's character. (हस्तलेख विशेषज्ञ)

**Example:** The graphologist concluded that the writer’s handwriting suggested a creative and analytical personality.

**"Graphologist"** is derived from the Greek words "graph" (writing) and "logos" (study). It is a niche field related to personality assessment through handwriting analysis.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Graphologist**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Calligrapher** (सुलेखक): A person skilled in beautiful handwriting or calligraphy.

**Example:** The calligrapher created stunning invitations with intricate designs.

**Typographer** (मुद्रक): A person who designs or arranges printed text and typefaces.

**Example:** The typographer chose the perfect font to complement the book's theme.

**Linguist** (भाषाविद): A person who studies languages and their structure.

**Example:** The linguist analyzed ancient scripts to decode the forgotten language.

questions.questionText:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who behaves in an unconventional manner.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Eccentric**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Eccentric"** refers to a person who behaves in a way that is unconventional or strange. (अजीब या असामान्य व्यवहार करने वाला व्यक्ति)

**Example:** The eccentric artist painted landscapes using only his feet.

An eccentric person often defies societal norms and is known for their unique or peculiar habits. (अलग या अनोखी आदतों के लिए जाना जाता है)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Eccentric**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Reticent** (मितभाषी): A person who is reserved or unwilling to communicate their thoughts and feelings.

**Example:** Despite her reticent nature, she managed to deliver a heartfelt speech.

**Egotist** (अहंकारी): A person who is excessively self-centered and talks too much about themselves.

**Example:** He is such an egotist that he always brings every conversation back to himself.

**Stickler** (सख्त अनुशासनप्रिय व्यक्ति): A person who insists on strict adherence to rules or standards.

**Example:** The teacher was a stickler for punctuality and never allowed late submissions.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Someone is bound to notice your absence.

options.text: Your absence is bound to be noticed.
Your absence is bound to be noticed by everyone.
Your absence is bound to notice by someone.
Your absence is bound to be notice.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
In the active voice, the sentence is: "Someone is bound to notice your absence."
To convert to passive voice: Place the object "your absence" at the beginning.
Change the active verb form "is bound to notice" to "is bound to be noticed" (passive structure).
Avoid unnecessary additions like "by everyone" unless explicitly mentioned in the context.
Ensure grammatical correctness and clarity in the passive sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Your absence is bound to be noticed."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2: **"Your absence is bound to be noticed by everyone." – While grammatically correct, it adds "by everyone," which is not present in the original sentence.
**Option 3: **"Your absence is bound to notice by someone." – Incorrect structure; "to notice" cannot be used in passive voice.
**Option 4: **"Your absence is bound to be notice." – Grammatically incorrect; "notice" should be "noticed."

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Don't you teach English to seventh graders?

options.text: Don't English taught by you to seventh graders?
Do English taught by you to seventh graders?
Isn't English taught by you to seventh graders?
Did English taught by you to seventh graders?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
In the active voice, the sentence is: "Don't you teach English to seventh graders?"
To convert to passive voice: Place the object "English" at the beginning.
Change the active verb form "teach" to "is taught" (present simple passive).
Add "by you" to indicate the original subject performing the action.
Ensure the sentence retains the negative and interrogative structure ("Isn't English taught by you to seventh graders?").

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Isn't English taught by you to seventh graders?"*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: **"Don't English taught by you to seventh graders?" – Incorrect sentence structure and verb form.
**Option 2: **"Do English taught by you to seventh graders?" – Incorrect tense and interrogative structure.
**Option 4: **"Did English taught by you to seventh graders?" – Incorrect tense and verb form.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Let the plot of the movie be kept a secret.

options.text: Keep the plot of the movie a secret.
The plot of the movie is a secret.
Let us kept the plot of the movie a secret.
Kept the plot of the movie a secret.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

The sentence is written in passive voice, and the task is to convert it into active voice.
Passive voice structure: "Let + object + be + past participle."
To convert the sentence into active voice, we remove "Let" and start with the imperative verb directly.
The correct active voice sentence is: "Keep the plot of the movie a secret."
The verb "Keep" is in imperative form, directly addressing the subject.
This conversion maintains the intended meaning of the sentence while correctly structuring it in active voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Keep the plot of the movie a secret."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2:** "The plot of the movie is a secret." – This is not a conversion of the sentence but a different statement.
**Option 3:** "Let us kept the plot of the movie a secret." – Incorrect grammar ("kept" should be "keep").
**Option 4:** "Kept the plot of the movie a secret." – Incorrect sentence structure; lacks a subject.

questions.questionText:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

The only disadvantage with teaching is repeating the same curriculum again and again.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Key Points**

The error lies in the use of the preposition "**with**" after the noun "**disadvantage**."
Certain nouns take specific prepositions to form a standard collocation. When referring to a drawback or a negative feature of something, the preposition "**of**" is used.
The correct phrase should be "**disadvantage of teaching**," which correctly identifies the activity to which the disadvantage belongs.
Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The only **disadvantage of teaching** is repeating the same curriculum again and again."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "The only" **– This part is grammatically correct as it functions as a determiner identifying a specific singular noun.
**Option 3: "is repeating the same"** – This part is correct; "repeating" acts as a gerund serving as the subject complement.
**Option 4: "curriculum again and again."** – This part is correct. While "again and again" might seem redundant with "repeating," it is a common idiomatic expression used for emphasis to show monotony.
**Usage of 'Disadvantage to':** We use "disadvantage to" when referring to a person or group that is negatively affected (e.g., "The new tax is a disadvantage to low-income families").

questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The wife has a strange influence ________ her husband.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**over**'.

**Key Points**

The preposition "**over**" is used to indicate a dominating or controlling influence in this context.
The sentence describes the wife's influence on her husband, which fits the usage of the word "**over**."
**Options 1, 2**, and **4** are incorrect because they do not convey the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"The wife has a strange influence **over** her husband."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "after"** is incorrect because "after" does not describe influence.
**Option 2: "before"** is incorrect because "before" does not relate to influence.
**Option 4: "under"** is incorrect because "under" implies submission rather than influence.

questions.questionText:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The principal stated that the proposed plan was in accordance to the guidelines issued by the education department.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**in accordance with the guidelines**'.

**Key Points**

The phrase **"in accordance with"** is the correct usage and is commonly used to refer to compliance or agreement with a set of rules, regulations, or guidelines.
The given sentence uses the incorrect phrase **"in accordance to"**, which is grammatically wrong.
**Option 2: "in accordance for"** is incorrect because the preposition "for" does not fit the required grammatical structure.
**Option 3: "in accordance on"** is incorrect because "on" is not appropriate in this context.
**Option 4: "No improvement required"** is incorrect because the existing sentence needs improvement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"The principal stated that the proposed plan was **in accordance with the guidelines** issued by the education department."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2: "in accordance for"** is grammatically incorrect because "for" does not work with "accordance" in this context.
**Option 3: "in accordance on"** is grammatically incorrect because "on" is not suitable with "accordance" here.
**Option 4: No improvement required** is incorrect because the phrase "in accordance to" is wrong and needs to be replaced.

questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

Many patriots have lost their lives fighting ________ freedom.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

**Key Points**

The preposition "**for**" is used to indicate the purpose or reason for an action.
In the given sentence, the correct preposition is "**for**" because the phrase "fighting for freedom" describes the purpose of the patriots' actions.
**Options 1, 3,** and **4** are incorrect as they do not convey the intended meaning in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"Many patriots have lost their lives fighting **for** freedom."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "in"** is incorrect because "fighting in freedom" does not make logical sense.
**Option 3: "through"** is incorrect because "fighting through freedom" is not a meaningful phrase.
**Option 4: "of"** is incorrect because "fighting of freedom" does not convey the intended meaning.

questions.questionText:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively and are fixed in their positions. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. Soon all was quiet in the house: everyone was asleep.
A. The snowstorm had not subsided; the wind blew in their faces as if trying to stop the young criminal.
B. Her maid followed her with two bundles.
C. They descended into the garden.
D. Masha wrapped herself in a shawl, put on a warm cloak, took her small box in her hand, and went down the back staircase.
S2. With difficulty they reached the end of the garden.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Key Points**

The sentences need to be rearranged logically to maintain the coherence and unity of the paragraph.
**Sentence D** introduces the action of Masha preparing to go out and descending the stairs, so it is the first logical sentence after S1.

questions.questionText:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: "No improvement required."

I feel frustrated that she keeps reverting back to her bad habits after brief phases of positive change.

options.text: keeps reverting to her bad habits
keeps reverting backward to her bad habits
keeps reverting forth to her bad habits

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**keeps reverting to her bad habits**'.

**Key Points**

The word "**revert**" inherently means "to go back" or "return to a previous state," so the use of "back" in the original sentence is redundant.
Option 1, "**keeps reverting to her bad habits**," removes the redundancy and provides a grammatically correct and concise sentence.
Option 2 ("**keeps reverting backward to her bad habits**") repeats the redundancy by adding "backward," which is unnecessary.
Option 3 ("**keeps reverting forth to her bad habits**") is incorrect because "reverting forth" is not a valid usage of the verb "revert."
Option 4 ("**No improvement required**") is incorrect because the original sentence contains redundancy that needs to be corrected.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"I feel frustrated that she **keeps reverting to her bad habits** after brief phases of positive change."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2:** "keeps reverting backward to her bad habits" is incorrect because "reverting" already implies going back, making "backward" redundant.
**Option 3:** "keeps reverting forth to her bad habits" is incorrect because "reverting forth" does not make sense in standard English usage.
**Option 4:** "No improvement required" is incorrect because the original sentence has a redundancy that needs correction.

questions.questionText: What does the fox symbolize in Ted Hughes’ poem The Thought Fox?

options.text: The writer’s loneliness and disconnection with nature
The slowly emerging imaginative power and creative inspiration in the writer’s mind
The nature’s destructive power that hinders the poet's writing
The factory development that eclipses the countryside and art.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Key Points**

***Option 2: The slowly emerging imaginative power and creative inspiration in the writer’s mind.***

The passage explicitly states that the fox **"represents the poet's imaginative powers"** and the **"symbolism of poetic inspiration."**
It further explains that this inspiration **"appears in the poem part by part"** (nose, eyes, prints, shadows), much like how a literary work is slowly composed rather than written in one go.

***Option 1: The writer’s loneliness and disconnection with nature.***

This is **incorrect**. While the passage mentions "loneliness," it defines it as the **absence of creative powers**, not the fox itself. The fox is the *solution* to that loneliness.

***Option 3: The nature’s destructive power that hinders the poet's writing.***

This is **incorrect**. The fox is used as a **positive** symbol of inspiration that allows the poet to fill the blank pages, not a destructive force that stops him.

***Option 4: The factory development that eclipses the countryside and art.***

This is **incorrect**. The passage makes no mention of industrialization, factories, or the eclipse of the countryside.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

**Additional Information**

**Animal Imagery**: Ted Hughes is famous for using intense, often violent animal imagery to explore human nature and the subconscious. In this poem, the fox is a "thought" made physical.
**Structure**: The poem follows the fox as it moves from the dark forest into the "dark hole of the head," ending with the page being printed.
**Loneliness**: In the context of the poem, the poet is sitting alone at night. This physical isolation provides the space for internal "imaginative powers" to manifest.

questions.questionText: Why does the poet describe a sense of loneliness in the poem?

options.text: As he is going through a dry creative period, even though he is in the middle of a crowd.
As he is literally pushed away in a forest far from any human being.
As he considers himself an outsider to the social group and does not want to interact with anyone at all.
As he remembers the good old days of his childhood, he longs for the countryside life very much.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Key Points**

***Option 1: As he is going through a dry creative period, even though he is in the middle of a crowd.***

The passage explicitly clarifies the nature of the poet's isolation: **"this loneliness is not the absence of people around him, but the absence of Creative powers."**
A "dry creative period" is a common literary way to describe the **absence of inspiration** or "Creative powers" mentioned in the text. Even if people are physically present, the poet feels "lonely" because he cannot connect with his own imagination.

***Option 2: As he is literally pushed away in a forest far from any human being.***

This is **incorrect**. The passage states that the fox is an **image** or **symbol** and that the loneliness is specifically *not* about the physical absence of people.

***Option 3: As he considers himself an outsider to the social group...***

This is **incorrect**. The text focuses entirely on the **process of poetic inspiration** and the "blank pages," rather than the poet's social standing or his desire to interact with others.

***Option 4: As he remembers the good old days of his childhood...***

This is **incorrect**. There is no mention of childhood, nostalgia, or a longing for the countryside life in the provided passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Additional Information**

**Writer's Block**: The phrase "his fingers move, but the pages remain blank" is a classic description of writer's block. The "loneliness" here is the frustration of having the tools to write but lacking the internal "spark."
**Symbolic Fox**: The fox is the **thought** that gradually becomes solid. Just as a fox's nose or eyes might appear first in the darkness of a forest, a poem often begins with a single, small image or "part" before the whole idea is formed.
**Loneliness as a Catalyst**: For many poets, this "special kind of loneliness" is necessary for the imagination to take shape, as it forces the mind to look inward for the "fox" to appear.

questions.questionText: How does the poem illustrate the process of writing a literary composition?

options.text: By demonstrating that poems are generally composed in a single session, with a constant and uninterrupted flow of ideas
By implying that creativity is a systematic process and adheres to a standardized formula
By representing inspiration as being cut up into pieces, coming bit by bit, before a whole thought is formed
By drawing attention to the fact that poetic ideas arrive already shaped, with no work or time needed

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Key Points**

***Option 3: By representing inspiration as being cut up into pieces, coming bit by bit, before a whole thought is formed.***

According to the passage, the poem serves as a **"perfect illustration"** of how inspiration arrives. It emphasizes that **"any literary composition is produced in parts."**
The fox doesn't appear all at once; instead, it manifests through fragments like **"nose images, Eyes, it's prints, or the Shadows."** This mirrors the non-linear and gradual nature of creative writing.

***Option 1: By demonstrating that poems are generally composed in a single session...***

This is **incorrect**. The passage explicitly contradicts this, stating that a literary composition is **"seldom written in one sitting or in one go."**

***Option 2: By implying that creativity is a systematic process...***

This is **incorrect**. While there is a process, the text describes it as **symbolic and imaginative** (represented by an animal in the dark) rather than a rigid, standardized formula.

***Option 4: By drawing attention to the fact that poetic ideas arrive already shaped...***

This is **incorrect**. The text mentions the poet's **"loneliness"** and **"blank pages,"** suggesting that ideas require effort and time to materialize from the initial "shadows" into a complete work.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Additional Information**

**Metaphorical Manifestation**: The "Fox" in Ted Hughes' poem is often interpreted as a thought that "enters the dark hole of the head." The poem itself is the result of that thought finally becoming "printed" on the page.
**Loneliness of the Creator**: The text highlights a specific type of isolation. It's not about being alone physically, but about the **internal void** one feels when the "Creative powers" are absent.
**Synecdoche**: The author uses parts (nose, eyes) to represent the whole (the fox/the poem). This literary device reinforces the idea that writing is an incremental process.

questions.questionText: What is the significance of animal imagery in The Thought Fox?

options.text: It gives a bright picture of the countryside, not connected to the theme of creativity
It highlights the anxiety of the poet in regard to nature and its unpredictability
It points out the drawbacks of industrialization in relation to nature and its inhabitants.
It hides the abstract idea of poetic inspiration under a visible, palatable metaphor

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Key Points**

***Option 4: It hides the abstract idea of poetic inspiration under a visible, palatable metaphor.***

The passage explicitly states that **"the symbolism of poetic inspiration is concealed behind the animal imagery."**
Poetic inspiration is an **abstract** concept (something that cannot be seen or touched). By using the **fox** as a metaphor, Ted Hughes makes this abstract process **visible** and **palatable** (easier to understand or digest) for the reader.
The "part-by-part" description of the fox (nose, eyes, prints) serves as a physical representation of how a poem gradually takes shape in the mind.

***Option 1: It gives a bright picture of the countryside...***

This is **incorrect**. The passage confirms that the imagery is directly **"symbolic of the process of poetic inspiration,"** contradicting the idea that it is not connected to the theme of creativity.

***Option 2: It highlights the anxiety of the poet in regard to nature...***

This is **incorrect**. While there is a sense of "loneliness" mentioned, it is a **creative loneliness** (the absence of ideas), not an anxiety about the unpredictability of nature itself.

***Option 3: It points out the drawbacks of industrialization...***

This is **incorrect**. The passage does not discuss industrialization, factories, or environmental drawbacks. It focuses entirely on **literary composition**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

**Additional Information**

**Metaphor vs. Symbol**: A metaphor directly compares two unlike things. Here, the fox *is* the thought. As a symbol, the fox represents the wild, untameable, and sudden nature of a **creative spark**.
**Animal Poetry**: Ted Hughes is known as an "animal poet." He often used animals to bridge the gap between the **human intellect** and the **instinctual world**.
**The "Internal" Forest**: In the poem, the setting is both a literal dark night and a metaphorical "forest" of the poet's mind where the "Thought Fox" lives.

questions.questionText: Why is The Thought Fox considered one of Hughes’ most celebrated early poems?

options.text: For the reason that it deals with the poet's intimate relations rather than his art in the making
Since the poem deals with the themes of the countryside and the industrialization of Northern Ireland
Due to the fact that it reveals the mystery of the creative process by means of abundant, vivid imagery
As the poem does not use metaphors at all and only gives a literal account of the situation

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Key Points**

***Option 3: Due to the fact that it reveals the mystery of the creative process by means of abundant, vivid imagery.***

The passage describes the poem as a **"perfect illustration"** of how poetic inspiration comes to a writer.
It "reveals the mystery" by showing that inspiration is not a sudden, complete event but a **gradual process**, which Hughes captures through **"vivid imagery"** of the fox appearing part by part (nose, eyes, prints).
The use of the fox as a symbol for **imaginative powers** is what makes the poem a celebrated early work.

***Option 1: For the reason that it deals with the poet's intimate relations...***

This is **incorrect**. The passage explicitly states that the poem is about **"the process of poetic inspiration"** (art in the making) rather than the poet's personal or intimate relationships.

***Option 2: Since the poem deals with the themes of the countryside and industrialization...***

This is **incorrect**. While Ted Hughes often wrote about the countryside, this specific passage makes no mention of **industrialization** or Northern Ireland.

***Option 4: As the poem does not use metaphors at all...***

This is **incorrect**. The text clarifies that the poem is **"symbolic"** and that the imagery **"conceals"** the meaning, which is the definition of metaphorical writing.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Additional Information**

**Animal as Idea**: In "The Thought Fox," the fox is not a real animal in a literal forest; it is an **idea** emerging from the "forest" of the poet's mind.
**Creative Loneliness**: The passage emphasizes that the poet's "loneliness" is a necessary state for **creation**. Without this space, the "fox" of inspiration cannot find its way to the page.
**Vividness**: By using specific body parts of the fox (nose, eyes), Hughes makes the internal **act of thinking** feel as real and physical as an animal walking through the snow.
